backend/main.mo: Motoko canister defining user roles, provider/client profiles, jobs, and helper view converters with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping feature requirements to affected frontend files and components.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each major frontend file in the project.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base styles defining OKLCH theme variables for light and dark mode plus global styling.
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell loading the React app entry script into the root div.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app container handling authentication, role-based routing, and page navigation using React Query.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering header, footer, main content, and the support drawer.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Provides a login/logout button using Internet Identity, handling login state, errors, and clearing cached queries.
frontend/src/components/auth/RoleOnboard: Displays a role selection UI and submits the chosen user role through a mutation.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer with branding, support drawer trigger, and caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Responsive header with logo, role-based navigation, support trigger, login button, and mobile menu.
frontend/src/components/location/Locatio: Lets users enter or auto-fill location data using geolocation, updating address and coordinates.
frontend/src/components/providers/Provid: Shows provider details including name, rate, category, location, ratings, and verification status.
frontend/src/components/ratings/StarRati: Interactive 1–5 star rating input with optional readonly mode.
frontend/src/components/support/SupportD: Provides a drawer with phone and email support contact options.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to the user’s identity, recreating and invalidating queries on identity change.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Manages Internet Identity auth state, providing identity, login, logout, and status tracking context.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Contains React Query hooks for user profiles, roles, provider profiles, provider search, and job-related mutations.
frontend/src/index.css: Configures Tailwind layers and defines light/dark theme CSS variables for colors, borders, and backgrounds.
frontend/src/lib/categories.ts: Defines service categories with icons and business types plus helper functions for lookup and label formatting.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity providers and loads global styles.
frontend/src/pages/backoffice/Verificati: Provides an admin interface to review providers, update verification status, and manage rejection reasons.
frontend/src/pages/client/CategoriesPage: Displays searchable service categories and navigates to results when a category is selected.
frontend/src/pages/client/MapViewPage.ts: Shows providers for a selected category with a placeholder map view and navigation back to list results.
frontend/src/pages/client/MyJobsPage.tsx: Shows a user's jobs with status badges and allows completing or canceling jobs and leaving ratings.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderDetail: Displays detailed provider info, handles hiring with job description, and shows verification and rating status.
frontend/src/pages/client/ProviderResult: Lists providers filtered by category and search, with navigation to details or map view.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Renders the marketing landing page with hero content and feature cards promoting the platform.
frontend/src/pages/provider/ProviderProf: Allows providers to view and update their profile, including business type, rate, contact info, and location.
frontend/src/pages/provider/Verification: Shows provider verification status and guidance, with placeholders for future document upload.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, storing, and clearing URL and session parameters, including hash-based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme, colors, fonts, animations, and container settings.
project_state.json: Defines the current project state for the Genz App, outlining features, architecture notes, known issues, and image requirements. Serves as the central configuration and status reference for ongoing development and fixes.
